verdict.rationale: Deel provides webhooks for real-time event notifications (e.g., HMAC-signed) and an MCP server exposing tools/actions (createTimeOffRequest, listOfContracts, etc.) that AI agents can invoke, giving the building blocks for event-driven automation. However, there's no evidence of a native rules engine where users define 'if event X then action Y' logic within Deel itself—automation requires external glue code or agent orchestration.
